contradictions.a: 也此約麤細相依之門說爲無前
contradictions.b: 又此約麤細相依之門，以說無始
contradictions.why: A says 'no front' (無前), B interprets this as 'no beginning' (無始).

contradictions.a: 亦是上四相中處分別執著相也
contradictions.b: 亦是前四相中分別事識相。
contradictions.why: A identifies the phase as 'place/location discrimination' (處分別), while B identifies it as 'object-consciousness' (事識).

omissions.a: 又二意留惑爲自他也此約終教說

additions.b: 又留惑有二意：為自、為他。此依終教說。
